title: Fractal phenomenon in $c$- and $g$-vectors of the Markov quiver
summary: We study the $C$- and $G$-patterns associated with rank $3$ skew-symmetrizable matrices of $B$-invariant type, including the Markov quiver. Motivated by the self-contained simple mutations in Markov-type cluster algebras, we prove that large classes of subpatterns of modified $c$- and $g$-vectors are linearly isomorphic, yielding a fractal structure of the corresponding $G$-fan.
